review_candidates.title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer, SLED
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Build and maintain reusable technical assets including lab environments, demo flows, battlecards, and scripts to support a scalable AE-to-SE model. Technical Requirements Proficiency in Windows environments (registry, services, performance troubleshooting). Familiarity with Linux/macOS systems and basic command-line troubleshooting. About You 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role supporting enterprise level SLED customers
eligibility_evidence: We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.
Additional Information This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.
We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.
